summary: McKinsey & Company is global management consulting firm, founded in 1926. About 45,100 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $16.0 billion (2023). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 1 about growth or hiring; 2 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: The global management consultancy, with entry-level English-language roles in Amsterdam, an IND sponsor licence and very competitive applications.

culture.text: Its people often come from INSEAD, Wharton, LSE and Harvard and studied economics, business, finance or computer science.
It advises companies, governments and institutions and says it builds client capabilities rather than just handing over advice.
Current openings are 3 entry-level consulting roles in Amsterdam.

open.text: McKinsey & Company Netherlands is an IND recognised sponsor.
All 3 current openings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.

growth.text: It had about 45,100 staff and US$16 billion in revenue in 2023.

worth_knowing.text: Belgian and French prosecutors seized €65 million from McKinsey in a French tax fraud investigation.
Its LinkedIn postings get about 200 applicants on average, so expect stiff competition.
